name: arbitration-legal
description: International arbitration counsel work — starting with document production: build and review Redfern Schedules, draft IBA Article 3.3-compliant requests, and map objections to the Article 9.2 grounds. Seat- and rules-aware (ICC, LCIA, SIAC, HKIAC, UNCITRAL, ICSID; IBA vs. Prague Rules). Adapts to your side (Claimant or Respondent) and role (firm counsel, in-house, sole practitioner).
